evals.prompt: Generate a CLAUDE.md for this project and its three submodules, pointing each submodule back to the root
evals.expected_output: Root CLAUDE.md with wiki-managed section linking to all submodules; per-submodule CLAUDE.md with a parent link back to the root
expectations: Managed content wrapped in `<!-- wiki-managed: start -->` and `<!-- wiki-managed: end -->` markers
Root file lists every discovered submodule with a relative link
Each submodule file includes a Parent Project link back to the root CLAUDE.md
Content outside the managed markers is preserved byte-for-byte on re-generation

evals.prompt: Update the CLAUDE.md of a project I already edited manually (added a custom section at the top), without clobbering my additions
evals.expected_output: Only the content between the wiki-managed markers is replaced; the user's manual additions remain intact
expectations: Preserves all content above the `<!-- wiki-managed: start -->` marker
Preserves all content below the `<!-- wiki-managed: end -->` marker
Regenerates only the managed section from the current wiki state
Is idempotent on re-run when the wiki state has not changed
